steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
create_mandate for a new agent, empty token limits, allow_any_destination, 30-day window (mandate PDA 4snfZuq1…)
Fetched the mandate account: revoked=false, payment_count=0, owner and agent match
revoke by the owner; fetched the account again and revoked=true
evidence.functional_evidence: create_mandate landed, the mandate account was read back from devnet, an invalid window was rejected, and revoke flipped revoked to true. The pay path was not exercised.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet, then submit create_mandate / revoke). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same instructions were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/mandatekey.mjs.

limitations: pay was not exercised: it needs a token vault owned by the mandate PDA and a listed mint. update_mandate, withdraw and close_mandate are still TODOs in the program.
standard_limitation: Practice-environment evidence records specified behaviour under stated conditions. It is not a security audit, a guarantee of current availability or an endorsement of production use.
practice_boundary: This exercise applies only to the environment identified on this page. It does not authorise testing the original project or any production deployment.
